coverage_rules: Every requirement-bearing inventory entry has exactly one matrix row and one owning phase.
prototype_source means source path inspected; separate browser evidence must verify reachability.
required_native identifies preserved or owner-required behavior absent/incomplete in the demo.
New target paths are proposed, not created product files.
DEV-01/02 are pending proposals; latest deviation register governs.
Native and release evidence is pending implementation; no test pass implied.
